description.en: Ontology module for textile process types, concrete process executions, process parameters, target specifications and parameter settings across manufacturing, care, repair and end-of-life stages.

comments.en: The module separates process types from concrete executions, parameter types from concrete settings, and process controls from target product specifications. Product characteristics and assessment results remain in their dedicated modules.
